patterns.note: Content is presented in a narrow, fixed-width central column, creating generous side margins and a focused reading experience.
Monospace font is used extensively across headings, body text, and navigational elements, mimicking a command-line interface or code editor aesthetic.
A high-contrast dark mode palette is used, featuring white text on a black background, with minimal red accents for the logo and subtle highlights.
Project showcases utilize short video clips or animated GIFs as thumbnails, demonstrating project visuals dynamically rather than static images.
Horizontal dotted lines and bracketed labels are used to visually delineate major sections like 'About/Statement' and 'Work/Artifacts', reinforcing the terminal theme.

technique_notes: To achieve the terminal-like aesthetic, use a fixed-width, dark background color and a monospace font for all text. Incorporate ASCII-art inspired characters or symbols (like brackets and slashes) for navigation items, section dividers, and metadata labels.
Emphasize certain words or phrases in body text by applying an underline style, without making them interactive links. This draws attention to key information within paragraphs.

For project showcases, employ a horizontally scrolling gallery of embedded video players or GIF images, allowing users to quickly preview multiple projects without navigating away from the current view. Include minimal overlay text for project titles and dates.
